features.note: key+rim carve real volume on the machined bare-metal block; specular gradient across ribs, rotor face and flanges. Light sells the metal.
grey canopy holds a top-brighter/left-darker gradient -> volume, not flat fill. Door gaps + low louver catch light.
cutaway lighting separates airend->separator->cooler->outlet; copper stays legible against darker vessel.
fan blades + finger-guard read; marginal: dedicated light lifts the fan but the radiator core still sits near-black.
emissive green display self-lights readable; red mushroom e-stop on yellow collar with clean specular.

important_features.note: TEFC finned motor + terminal box + guarded coupling; dark paint a touch murky under fill but volume survives.
copper routes root->tip with warm speculars; a couple runs read slightly flat where fill washes highlight.
AIRTECH plate reads under grazing light; no real-brand logo.

defects: Aftercooler radiator core still reads as a black box under its dedicated -X light — fan lifts but the fin block does not read aluminium.
Hero lighting is product-flat with a weak contact shadow; canopy floats slightly off the floor.
Closed-hero canopy top edges lack a grazing rim (strong volume only in higher-DPR door/train shots).
Dark motor paint slightly muddy where blue fill overlaps in cutaway.
corrections: Raise/angle the dedicated aftercooler light across the fins so the -X radiator core reads pale aluminium, not a black box.
Add a firmer contact/ground shadow under the skid in the hero to anchor the product.
Add a grazing rim along the canopy top and vertical corners to sharpen volume in the closed hero.
Lower the blue fill on the motor so its finned form separates from shadow.
